---
title: "ES 114: Probability, statistics and data visualization"
subtitle: "January 2025 · IIT Gandhinagar"
---

::: {.lead}
A first-year course on reasoning with uncertainty and data: working with data in Python (NumPy, Pandas and
Matplotlib), sets and probability, conditional probability and Bayes' theorem, random variables and their
distributions, expectation and variance, joint distributions, sums of random variables, the law of large numbers,
and random vectors and principal component analysis. Every lecture's slides, notebooks, cheat sheet and short
videos are in the [lecture library](lectures.qmd).
:::

All communication is on the course Slack:
[join the ES 114 workspace](https://join.slack.com/t/es1142025/shared_invite/zt-2w15bop68-YdIMFQxAdUGFvOE7R3FM1Q).

::: {.callout-note}

## Prerequisites

None. This is a first-year undergraduate course.

## Reference textbooks

1. Chan, Stanley. "Introduction to Probability for Data Science." The University of Michigan Library, Michigan Publishing (2021). [Free digital copy](https://probability4datascience.com/)
2. Adhikari, Ani, John DeNero, and D. Wagner. "Computational and Inferential Thinking: The Foundations of Data Science." Second Edition. The University of California, Berkeley (2019). [Free digital copy](https://inferentialthinking.com/chapters/intro.html)
3. Deisenroth, Marc Peter, A. Aldo Faisal, and Cheng Soon Ong. Mathematics for Machine Learning. Cambridge University Press, 2020. [Free digital copy](https://mml-book.github.io/)
4. Spiegelhalter, David. The Art of Statistics: Learning from Data. Penguin UK, 2019.
5. Rougier, Nicolas. Scientific Visualization: Python + Matplotlib. 2021. [Free digital copy](https://github.com/rougier/scientific-visualization-book)
